summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change pointed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment. Worker thread was stuck in a wait state, so the queue backed up. The cause of the stall is not fully determined.
recommended: Validate that the payments-v2 endpoint is reachable before retrying the provider migration.
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on them.
Investigate why the worker stalled in the wait state.
